system.description:
You've been down and out. Perhaps you've recovered a bit, but you also might still be stuck in a terrible situation. Low on resources and luck, you did your best, but it often just wasn't good enough.

Qualities

Assign a d8, a d6, and a d6 to three of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.jLRoVcoc8Dz0Kiio]{Banter}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.zlx2bULfYfooNB03]{Criminal Underworld Info}

• Select from Physical qualities category

Principle

Choose a Responsibility principle.

Power Source

Roll d8, d8, d6 for power source selection.
